record.question: It is a great loss to a man _____________ he cannot laugh. Complete the sentence by supplying appropriate connecting word.
record.explanation: Answer D: that. “That” introduces the content clause explaining the loss: it is a great loss that he cannot laugh. Independent check: “That he cannot laugh” is the content clause specifying the loss. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/verbs-followed-by-prepositions-and-prepositions-followed-by-ing-forms; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses.
